description: Partition a bounded bipartite graph into even-reachable, odd-reachable, and unreachable Dulmage–Mendelsohn classes.

source.title: Bipartite Matching — Dulmage–Mendelsohn Decomposition
source.author: OI Wiki contributors
source.foundational_paper: A. L. Dulmage and N. S. Mendelsohn, Coverings of Bipartite Graphs, Canadian Journal of Mathematics 10 (1958), 517–534.
source.reuse: Algorithm descriptions and theorem attribution only; contract, code, fixtures, and port implementations are clean-room.

input.vertex_ids: left IDs are 0..L-1 and right IDs are 0..R-1; output order concatenates left vertices then right vertices
input.graph: simple bipartite graph; each left-right pair occurs at most once

output.meaning: Maximum matching size and the canonical even/odd/unreachable vertex classes.
output.encoding: (maximum_matching_size << 32) | sum(class_code[v] << (2*v)); class codes are E=0, O=1, U=2 in concatenated left-then-right vertex order.
output.maximum_result_derivation: Conservative packed-field ceiling: (6 << 32) | (2^24 - 1); the matching size is at most 6 and 12 vertices occupy 24 class bits.

algorithm_profile.primary: Compute a maximum bipartite matching with ascending-neighbor Kuhn DFS. Start an alternating-path BFS at every unmatched vertex, including unmatched vertices on both sides. Even states follow only unmatched edges; odd states follow only matched edges. Reachable parity gives E/O; vertices with neither parity are U.
algorithm_profile.independent: Enumerate every matching in the bounded graph, retain the vertices left unmatched by at least one maximum matching as E, mark their neighbors O, and label the remaining vertices U.
algorithm_profile.tie_policy: Matching construction scans left IDs and right IDs ascending. The DM partition is invariant across maximum matchings; no arbitrary matching edge is part of the encoded result.
algorithm_profile.class_meaning: E is even-reachable from an unmatched vertex by an alternating path; O is odd-reachable; U is unreachable from every unmatched vertex. E/O/U are disjoint and cover all vertices for a maximum matching.

complexity.primary_time: O(L*R + L*E + V+E) for bounded Kuhn matching and alternating BFS; L,R<=6 and E<=36
complexity.independent_time: O(number_of_partial_matchings * (L+R+E)); at most 13,327 matchings for K6,6
complexity.auxiliary_space: O(V+E) primary; O(V+E) independent recursion and graph state

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency masks, at most 24 alternating-path states, matching arrays, and 12 two-bit class codes.
